concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-extend-oauth-client-side-javascript-v3]] - JavaScript v3 client-side Connect-button guide for starting merchant consent with a server-generated Extend OAuth URL, with return-page display and environment parameter qualifications
warnings: Keep Braintree Extend OAuth distinct from Braintree Auth despite overlapping connected-merchant OAuth terminology and the Braintree Auth contact link on the page.
The assigned raw does not document Finish Later handling, authorization-code exchange, access-token creation, state validation or callback security; do not import those behaviors from Braintree Auth.

Treat production closed-beta and sandbox open-beta wording, the environment values and the return-page display rule as snapshot-qualified documentation, not proof of current availability, environment isolation, completed consent, credential issuance or payment execution.
